instruction.text: Vervollständige den Dialog und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

atoms.a: Hi Melanie, how is the school project going with your group?
atoms.b: Hi Melanie, how is the school project going with your ((group))?

atoms.a: Hi Dean. It's not going so well, actually. Jake always complains about everything we do. He's so picky and disapproves of every idea that we have.
atoms.b: Hi Dean, it's not going so well, actually. Jake always ((complains)) about everything we do. He's so ((picky)) and disapproves of every idea that we have.

atoms.a: Jake is in Melanie's group for the school project.
Jake is a supportive group member.
Sounds like he is someone who doesn't support his group members. Have you tried to talk to him?
atoms.b: Sounds like he is someone who doesn't ((support)) his group members. Have you tried to talk to him?

atoms.a: Yes, I organised a group meeting yesterday, but Jake is not responsible at all, so he didn't come.
atoms.b: Yes, I organised a group meeting yesterday, but Jake is not ((responsible)) at all, so he didn't come.

atoms.a: That's so selfish of him! I don't mean to gossip, but Jake should really try to be more helpful.
atoms.b: That's so ((selfish)) of him! I don't mean to ((gossip)), but Jake should really try to be more helpful.

instruction.text: Wähle alle Adjektive aus, die auf Jakes Verhalten zutreffen.

atoms.a: That's true, but he might have something personal going on. We shouldn't judge him too much.
atoms.b: That's true, but he might have something personal going on. We shouldn't ((judge)) him too much.

atoms.a: You're right, gossiping doesn't help. Maybe you could ask the teacher? Mrs. Johnson is very trustworthy.
atoms.b: You're right, gossiping doesn't help. Maybe you could ask the teacher? Mrs. Johnson is very ((trustworthy)).

atoms.a: Good idea, thank you! I'm sure she will be able to help me.
atoms.b: Good idea, thank you! I'm sure she will be able to ((help)) me.

instruction.text: Welcher Satz fasst die Unterhaltung am besten zusammen?

b: ++Melanie and Dean think that Jake is not being a responsible group member, but instead of gossiping about him, Melanie will ask the teacher for help.
Melanie and Dean think that Jake is not being a responsible group member, so they decide to talk to him about the problem instead of telling the teacher.
